parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors.

summary: Consolidation of bail bonds across multiple FIRs; petitioner filed writ under Article 32 seeking validation of single set of personal bond and sureties (Rs. 50,000) for 11 bail orders; States (Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Punjab, Uttarakhand) opposed on grounds that separate sureties required per FIR to prevent liability exceeding bond limits; Court rejected plea citing jurisdictional and procedural barriers, held each FIR requires distinct bond execution without cross-liability.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986 s.3(1)
final_judgment: Prayer for treating bonds/sureties from FIR No. 0030/2021 (Gurugram) as valid for 11 other cases rejected; separate bonds required for each FIR; petition dismissed.
